facts.fact: The Minister of Communications, Science and Technology said on a site visit that his Ministry will provide Tenesolo Community Council's office, then under construction, with an internet connection, and the head of the national web e-portal said the connections will use the Lesotho government data network; the connection is announced, not stated as live.
facts.system: internet connection of community council offices over the Lesotho government data network

facts.fact: One community council, Tenesolo, is named as to be given an internet connection, ten computers and a server by the Ministry of Communications, Science and Technology, and the Minister said the plan is to assist in connecting all the councils; no count of councils connected is given.
facts.system: internet connection of community council offices over the Lesotho government data network

facts.fact: The Tenesolo Community Council secretary said e-government will connect the office to internet access and to a data bank in Mohale's Hoek and make services accessible online; stated as intended, with the office building due to finish in 2018.
facts.system: internet connection of community council offices over the Lesotho government data network

facts.fact: The Ministry of Communications, Science and Technology is to provide the Tenesolo Community Council's internet connection, using the government data network, according to its Minister and the head of the national web e-portal.
facts.system: internet connection of community council offices over the Lesotho government data network

facts.fact: The Tenesolo Community Council secretary said the installation of the internet infrastructure is financed by the Ministry of Communications and co-financed by the African Development Bank; no amount is given.
facts.system: internet connection of community council offices over the Lesotho government data network

systems.owner: Ministry of Communications, Science and Technology
systems.tiers: to be used for all connections, starting with Tenesolo Community Council's office at Mants'onyane; plan stated to connect all councils
